idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks and the error rate rose to about 18%. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was skipped because it was only healthy in staging. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with about an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback version:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it was only ever healthy in staging, not production.
- **Result:** All three regions now run v2.3.0. The service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%. No change-manager approval was needed, since v2.3.0 has already been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2). It describes the failure, the rollback and the current state, and asks for the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent production-healthy release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it doesn't qualify).
